testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel a zoom window after its first corner ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its visible planar face occupies most of the viewport ✔ When the user chooses Zoom Window from the navigation bar Zoom menu ✔ And the user clicks a first corner within the face ✔ And the user presses Escape before choosing the opposite corner ✔ Then the status area displays Ready ✔ And the face retains its previous apparent size and position ✔ And the same part and orientation remain active
